extracted.name: Easy Pork and Sauerkraut
extracted.description: This easy pork and sauerkraut recipe is made in the slow cooker with garlic, beer, mustard, and apple for a hearty meal perfect for cold weather.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound pork roast, cut into 1 inch cubes
0.5 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle beer
instruction_lines: Stir undrained sauerkraut, pork cubes, beer, garlic, onion salt, dry mustard, and dill together in a slow cooker until well combined. Press apple half under other ingredients to submerge.
Cook on High for 1 hour. Reduce the heat to Low and continue cooking until pork is cooked through, about 5 more hours. Discard apple and serve.
